

```{r cars}
library(SC3)
library(scater)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scran)

expr_t <- t(mod_dense)  # SC3 needs genes in rows, cells in columns
mat <- as.matrix(expr_t)

# Create SingleCellExperiment
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(exprs = as.matrix(expr_t)))

rowData(sce)$feature_symbol <- rownames(sce)

assay(sce, "logcounts") <- log2(mat + 1)

colData(sce)$celltype_infercnv <- as.factor(mod_anno$celltype_infercnv)

sce <- sc3(sce, ks = 6, gene_filter = FALSE, biology = TRUE)  # gene_filter TRUE applies



# View cluster labels (for each k)
colData(sce)[, c("cellype_infercnv", grep("^sc3_", colnames(colData(sce)), value = TRUE))]

# Example plots:
# sc3_plot_consensus(sce, k = 3)
# sc3_plot_expression(sce, k = 3)

```

```{r}

sce <- runPCA(sce, exprs_values = "logcounts")
plotPCA(sce, colour_by = "celltype_infercnv")
df <- as.data.frame(colData(sce)[, c("celltype_infercnv", grep("^sc3_", colnames(colData(sce)), value = TRUE))])
View(df)

library(dplyr)

df_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(sc3_6_clusters, celltype_infercnv) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

print(df_summary)

rand_index <- function(labels1, labels2) {
  n <- length(labels1)
  
  # All pair indices
  combs <- combn(n, 2)
  
  # Agreements/disagreements
  agree_same <- sum((labels1[combs[1,]] == labels1[combs[2,]]) & 
                    (labels2[combs[1,]] == labels2[combs[2,]]))
  
  agree_diff <- sum((labels1[combs[1,]] != labels1[combs[2,]]) & 
                    (labels2[combs[1,]] != labels2[combs[2,]]))
  
  total_pairs <- ncol(combs)
  
  RI <- (agree_same + agree_diff) / total_pairs
  return(RI)
}



ri <- rand_index(df$celltype_infercnv, df$sc3_6_clusters)

print(ri)
```
